scientific.integrity: The primary PDF was inspected at the four original economic-loss objectives, the controlled state equations, the quadratic functional, the Pontryagin characterization, and the numerical interpretation of economic loss. The pages containing the model and adjoint/control formulas were visually inspected. A full-text multiobjective epidemic-control paper was inspected for the standard weighted-sum definition and its distinction between quadratic and linear control costs. The day-resolved first-public date follows the OpenAlex bibliographic record; the publisher reports online publication at month precision as June 2017. The bundled symbolic checker reconstructs the switching functions and objective-ranking reversal. Independent audit has not been performed.
scientific.limitations: The result diagnoses the scalarization step only. It does not claim that quadratic running costs are intrinsically inappropriate, does not recompute the numerical optimum, and does not reassess the epidemiological stability theory.

title: The published quadratic brucellosis objective is not a weighted-sum scalarization
